programme.title: Story of Kunning Palace ((100万个约定之宁安如梦))
programme.desc: Jiang Xue-ning Bai Lu went to great lengths to become the Empress. But she was forced to take her own life in the palace. Fast forward to the present, and Jiang Xue-nings wish is to stay away from power struggles and control her destiny. However, she still somehow enters the palace as a study partner and becomes Master Xie Weis Zhang Linghe pupil. While learning from Xie Wei, Jiang Xue-ning plots to prevent Yan Lin Zhou Junwei from getting involved in the coming-of-age incident. By following Jiang Xue-ning and Xie Weis strategy, the Yans manage to stay alive. After the coming-of-age crisis, Jiang Xue-ning unwittingly gets embroiled in the imperial court crackdown on Lord Pingnan rebels scheme. She and Zhang Zhe Wang Xingyue venture into enemy territory. At the critical moment, Jiang Xue-ning uses her body to shield arrows for Zhang Zhe. But the duo eventually cannot stay together. Hostile the State of Yue launches an invasion. First Princess Shen Zhi-yi Liu Xening does not hesitate to go down the road to making peace by marriage. To save her buddy Shen Zhi-yi, Jiang Xue-ning goes with Xie Wei to the north to deal with the State of Yue. While overcoming difficulties, Xie Wei does not mind getting hurt as he protects Jiang Xue-ning. The duo gradually have affectionate feelings for each other. However, an even more evil conspiracy gradually surfaces, and it astonishingly points to the truth about the Lord Pingnan incident from twenty years ago. Jiang Xue-ning and Xie Wei eventually team up to uncover the truth from yesteryear. Jiang Xue-ning also uses love to influence Xie Wei. The couple eventually find happiness. (江宁·白卢为成为皇帝做了很大的努力.但她被迫在宫殿中自杀.快速前进到现在,江宁的愿望是远离权力斗争,控制她的命运.然而,她仍然是某种程度上进入宫殿作为学习伙伴,成为伟先生的学生.在学习时,江宁阴谋阻止延周军在成年事件中参与.通过遵循江宁和徐伟战略,延们设法保持活着.在成年危机后,江宁无意地卷入了王朝的阴谋与伟王主张强的反抗.然而,她和伟王妃在成年后,最终会在伟王朝的两人之间进行和平,并最终无法在两人之间进行更深入的关系.但在两年后,)

programme.title: Happy Old Buddies ((开心老友记))
programme.desc: Many people may think that older adults do not have sexual needs, but surveys have shown that this is not the caseolder adults often experience less sexual activity due to various reasons. Clinical psychologist Lin Haoming from the Social Welfare Department explains the World Health Organizations definition of sexuality and offers advice for those hoping to rekindle their sex life with their partner. However, if one partner does not wish to resume sexual activity, how should both sides communicate? (许多人可能认为年长者没有性需求,但调查表明,年长者通常因各种原因而没有更多的性活动.社会福利部的临床心理学家林海明解释了世界卫生组织对性行为的定义,并为希望与伴侣重新启动性生活的人提供建议.)

programme.title: Gourmet Express ((美食新闻周报))
programme.desc: Hong Kong brings together global cuisines, and its unique dishes and down-to-earth fare have captured the close attention of discerning food lovers! Food hosts and presenters such as Icy Wong,Snowy Choi,Carmen Ngai,Carmaney Wong , Jessica Liu , Gillian Ng keep up with the latest food news and deals, delving into the stories behind the flavors. Gathering firsthand information on popular eateries across various platforms, the hosts personally line up and taste the food, providing genuine reviews. The production team follows the proprietors through their busy day, from sourcing ingredients and preparing materials to opening for business, uncovering the stories behind the flavors. (香港汇集全球菜,其独特的菜和精致的菜吸引了富有挑的爱好者! 食物主持人和主持人如Icy Wong,Snowy Choi,Carmen Ngai,Carmaney Wong,Jessica Liu,Gillian Ng跟上最新的食物新闻和交易,深入了解味道背后的故事. 收集了各种平台的流行餐厅的第一手信息,主持人亲自排列并品尝食物,提供了真实的评论.即使没有餐饮选择的餐厅也很受欢迎.)

programme.desc: From Hopscotch to Hands Up, TVBs childrens programs have accompanied childrens growth, creating countless wonderful childhood memories. (从Hopscotch到“举手”,TVB儿童节目伴随儿童成长,创造了无数美好的童年记忆。老童节目主播Tam Yuk-ying、Lai Chi-shan和盖赛宝也与你们一起成长!每集的主题将不同,邀请不同时代的主持人重新团聚和回忆过去。十年已经过去,过去年的年轻接待者和参与者都长大了很多。东道主已经离开自己的路去寻找这些人,与每个人一起重新体验那些难忘的时刻。经典的空中飞跃段有着无数快乐的回忆。东道主和客人阿里·李将引导新一代儿童度过乐趣。)

programme.title: Dolce Vita 2022 ((港生活·港享受 2022))
programme.desc: Hong Kong life is vibrant and diverse, and Hong Kong Life, Hong Kong Enjoyment presents both sophisticated and elegant lifestyles and down-to-earth, high-quality experiences. The program combines diverse themes, exploring different areas in each episode and inviting elites from various industries to share their secrets to success. (香港生活充满活力和多样性,香港生活,香港愉悦呈现了复杂和优雅的生活方式和实在的,高质量的体验.该节目结合了各种主题,探索了每个集中的不同领域,并邀请了来自不同行业的精英分享成功的秘密.)

programme.title: Hands Up 2026 ((举起手来! 2026))
programme.desc: The brand-new childrens program Hands Up encourages kids to ask questions bravely, express themselves, and pursue their goals! Members of the mascot Sauce Family join the hosts in performing short skits, accompanying everyone for joyful moments. The show will also feature a variety of childrens songs, allowing kids to sing along while learning practical life knowledge. (儿童节目"手上升"鼓励孩子们勇敢地问问题,表达自己,追求自己的目标!子家族成员加入主持人表演短短剧,陪伴所有人享受快乐的时刻.节目还将有各种儿童歌曲,让孩子们一起唱歌,同时学习实用生活知识.)

programme.title: Ratman To The Rescue ((过街英雄))
programme.desc: Gossip magazine journalist Tong Leung-sing Sammy has unfortunately lost his left ear in a traffic accident. He gains mystical rat power after undergoing transplant surgery. Leung-sing keeps creating fake news just to benefit himself. He clashes with righteous policewoman Sung Hoi-yan Priscilla Wong, causing both of them to lose their jobs. With the support of her uncle Ming Kwan-ngai KK Cheung, Hoi-yan becomes a private investigator. Leung-sing is forced to help Hoi-yan with her investigation activities as Hoi-yan catches him using his mystical power to peep at goddess Ming Cheuk-kei Zoie Tam. Gold digger Tong Mei-fun Kamen Kong is cruelly harassed as rich clan heir Tsui Tsun-wai Daniel Chau and she become foes. Mei-fun forgives Tsun-wai and offers to help him as Tsun-wai gets into a difficult situation. Leung-sing becomes increasingly arrogant as he uses to his mystical power to solve cases. Meanwhile, Hoi-yan shockingly finds out Kwan-ngais real character. Leung-sing faces the danger of exhausting his mystical power and becoming a rat as he helps Hoi-yan. (柳亮在一次交通事故中不幸失去了左耳,在接受移植手术后,他获得了神秘的老鼠权。良星不断制造假消息以为自己谋利。他与正直的女警察宋海燕王普西利亚(Sung Hoi-yan Pricilla Wong)发生冲突,导致他们两人失业。在她叔叔Ming Kwan-ngai KK KK 张的支持下,贺燕成为私人调查员。梁星被迫帮助慧妍探查她的调查活动,因为他利用神秘的力量去探明Ming Cheuk-kei Zoie Tam女神。金发的Tong Mei-fun Kamen Kong作为富有的家族继承人,Tsui Tsun-wai Daniel Chau 和她成为了敌人,受到残酷的骚扰。Mi-fun-fun 原谅徐伟,并主动提出帮助他陷入困境。梁星越来越傲慢,因为他用自己的权力来解决案子。与此同时,Hoi-yyan 突然地发现我本人的心力和心力。)

programme.title: Gourmet Express ((美食新闻周报))
programme.desc: Hong Kong brings together global cuisines, and its unique dishes and down-to-earth fare have captured the close attention of discerning food lovers! Food hosts and presenters such as Icy Wong,Snowy Choi,Carmen Ngai,Carmaney Wong , Jessica Liu , Gillian Ng keep up with the latest food news and deals, delving into the stories behind the flavors. Gathering firsthand information on popular eateries across various platforms, the hosts personally line up and taste the food, providing genuine reviews. Even takeout-only eateries with no dine-in option are in high demandwhat are the must-try picks? Running a food business inevitably comes with its own mix of sweet, sour, bitter, and spicy experiences. The production team follows the proprietors through their busy day, from sourcing ingredients and preparing materials to opening for business, uncovering the stories behind the flavors. (香港汇集全球菜,其独特的菜和精致的菜吸引了富有挑的爱好者! 食物主持人和主持人如Icy Wong,Snowy Choi,Carmen Ngai,Carmaney Wong,Jessica Liu,Gillian Ng跟上最新的食物新闻和交易,深入了解味道背后的故事. 收集了各种平台的流行餐厅的第一手信息,主持人亲自排列并品尝食物,提供了真实的评论.即使没有餐饮选择的餐厅也很受欢迎.)

programme.title: Want To De-stress (想摆脱压力)
programme.desc: Many urban dwellers are constantly striving for a living and a career, leaving no time for relaxation. The accumulated stress can quickly trigger health problems. This program invites professionals from various fields, such as aromatherapists, music therapists, color therapists, nutritionists, and psychologists, to use accessible methods, including case studies and fun quizzes, to bring out the harmony and balance of the five senses, helping viewers instantly release stress. Celebrities will also be invited to have candid conversations with the host, sharing their effective methods for coping with the heavy pressures of life and work. The program also includes many interesting stress-reduction tips to deepen viewers understanding of the importance of stress reduction for health. (许多城市居民都在为生活和职业生涯而努力,没有时间放松,积累的压力会迅速引发健康问题。这个计划邀请各个领域的专业人员,如芳香疗法师、音乐治疗师、彩色治疗师、营养学家和心理学家,使用无障碍的方法,包括案例研究和有趣的测验,以体现五感的和谐与平衡,帮助观众立即释放压力。这个计划还将邀请名人与东道方进行坦率的对话,分享他们应对生活和工作沉重压力的有效方法。这个计划还包括许多有趣的减压提示,以加深观众对减压对健康的重要性的理解。)

programme.title: Try It? Really? Sr.2 ((試真D Sr.2))
programme.desc: Midlife, Sing Shine! 4 has officially launched, continuing the success of the previous three seasons and once again providing a stage for singing enthusiasts to pursue their dreams. This season expands its recruitment efforts to North America and Australia, with several TVB artists participating masked, igniting the flame of music globally and illuminating the hearts of countless dreamers. Stephanie Che continues to host, offering her warm smile to the contestants Maria Cordero, Chow Kwok-fung, Cheung Ka-tim, Hai-er, and Gu Ya-wei also serve as judges, providing professional feedback and encouragement to the participants. On this new seasons stage, everyone will weave an even more moving chapter with music, continuing the heartfelt story of Midlife, Sing Shine! 4. (中世纪, Sing Shine! 4 正式启动,继续前三个赛季的成功,并再次为歌唱爱好者提供舞台,以追求梦想。这个赛季将招募工作扩大到北美和澳大利亚,一些TVB艺术家蒙上面具,在全球点燃音乐火焰,点亮无数梦想家的心。 Stephanie Che 继续担任东道主,向参赛者Maria Cordeo、Chow Kwok-fung、张家廷、海尔和Gu Ya-wei提供热烈的笑容,向参赛者们提供法官,向参与者提供专业反馈和鼓励。在这个新赛季阶段,每个人都会用音乐来更感动的一章,继续讲述中世纪的衷心故事,Sing Shine!)

programme.desc: Dear Leslie 70 is a TVB Jade memorial music special honoring the 70th birth anniversary of Hong Kong legend Leslie Cheung. The show celebrates his legacy across Cantopop, TV, and cinema by showcasing iconic archival performances, classic hits like Monica and Chase, and tribute covers by fellow artists. programme.desc: Li Jiading Master Ding, the tough guy, is undoubtedly a master of martial arts, but it turns out his culinary skills are equally impressive! Master Ding has set up Master Dings Kitchen, partnering with the discerning food connoisseur Tan Yuying. In autumn and winter, many people love fragrant claypot rice, especially the crispy rice crust. But have you ever seen claypot rice with crispy rice on both sides? Watch Master Ding show off his skills and teach you how! (李建丁师,坚强的老师丁,无疑是武术的士,但他厨艺技巧也令人印象深刻!丁师与精明的食品熟练者坦尤宁合作建立了士丁厨房.每集都带着观众去寻找他们最喜欢的食材,丁师亲自做各种特色的菜,和甜点,提供怀旧的堪敦式美食!如何以负担得起的价格做真实的传统烤?如何控制鱼时的热量和时间?秋冬,许多人喜欢香水米,特别是脆的米皮.但你有没有见过士丁的米米两侧都显示了米米的米技巧吗?看看看!)

programme.desc: Thailand expert Hu Huichong once again leads the Tom Yum Family members to introduce the latest travel information in Bangkok, including glamorous massage parlors with perfect photo spots, newly opened shopping malls with sky parks, and buffet restaurants hailed as the pinnacle of Bangkok tourism. She will accompany Hu Huichong to visit Ayutthaya, Khao Yai, and other areas around Bangkok, recommending popular holiday destinations for locals. Besides unboxing hotels, they will also visit pseudo-Japanese photo spots and hotel-attached childrens playgrounds, guaranteeing an authentic Thai experience. programme.title: Mystery Files ((苏联神秘档案))
programme.desc: Love is an extremely complex subject, surrounded by numerous environmental factors that can alter our dreams and understanding of romance. These factorsranging from changes in age and the rise of internet culture to the emergence of scams and other seemingly unusual reasonshave led to bizarre, worldview-shattering love stories in society. The TVB Plus live show Mystery Files hosted by Fire Lee, Jinny Ng, and Randal Tsang, invites people from all walks of life, celebrity guests, and relationship experts to discuss each episodes theme. With unique perspectives and thought-provoking questions, they boldly explore emotional dilemmas, while also welcoming viewers to join the conversation and solve problems together through the live chatroom and call-ins. (爱是一个极其复杂的话题,周围环境因素众多,可以改变我们的梦想和对浪漫的理解。 从年龄变化、互联网文化的兴起、骗局和其他看似不寻常的原因等诸多因素导致社会上出现奇特的、充满世界观的爱情故事。 由Fire Lee、Jinny Ng和Randal Tsang主办的TVB+实况节目神秘文件邀请各行各业的人、名人客人和关系专家讨论每个事件的主题。 他们以独特的视角和发人深省的问题,大胆地探索情感困境,同时也欢迎观众通过现场聊天室和来宾参与对话并共同解决问题。)

programme.title: You Are Not Alone Again ((中文))
programme.desc: You Are Not Alone triumphantly returns! In its second season, the show is once again led by the King of Ghosts Leung Si Ho, together with co-hosts Wong Yiu Ying and Wong Chi Yan, as well as editors Wong Ying Yeuk and Tong Chi Yan, bringing audiences even more frights and surprises. Each episode focuses on a different supernatural theme, featuring heavyweight guests who share ghost stories and reveal the secrets of rituals and industry customs. With a world full of mysteries, the program gathers paranormal news from around the globe, and Chi Yan will travel to South Korea and Taiwan to explore local supernatural phenomena. Real-time interaction with the audience is also a highlight of Spirit Connection, with the team closely following live broadcasts, (你并非孤军奋战的归来者!在第二个赛季,节目再次由鬼王梁西浩王(Ghosts Leung Si Ho)和黄耀英、黄志燕(Wong Yiu Ying Ying)和编辑王志燕(Wong Ying Yeuk)和黄智燕(Tong Chi Yan)共同主持,让观众们更加高兴和惊讶。每集都关注不同的超自然主题,由分享幽灵故事并揭露宗教仪式和行业习俗秘密的重量级客人组成。在充满神秘的世界里,节目汇集了来自全球的超自然新闻,而志燕将前往南韩和台湾探索当地超自然现象。与观众的实时互动也是“精神联系”的亮点,与团队密切跟踪实况广播,)

programme.title: Blessing of Formosa
programme.desc: The beauty of folklore is all around us in Taiwan, but we often overlook it and fail to appreciate and feel it. The aim of this program is to promote the beauty of Taiwanese folklore and bring folklore to life. This program showcases folk culture regardless of race or religion, and presents travel information in a fun way, combining easy-to-understand folk culture knowledge with the mission of passing on folk culture. The audience can learn more about folk cultural products such as handicrafts, antiques, temple folklore, as well as short stories about the gods, and information about local tourism. It is an educational and entertaining way to travel and learn about folklore.

programme.title: Top Singers
programme.desc: The show Top Singers aims to spotlight outstanding Taiwanese singers and composers, setting a new standard in the industry. Combining elements of competition, variety, and personal stories, the show welcomes participants of all ages. Its goals include discovering grassroots talent, innovating Taiwanese song performance styles, and involving more local talent in song composition to infuse new life into Taiwanese music.

programme.title: Show Biz

programme.title: Love, Now
programme.desc: Lan Shi De, who lost his first love in college, reunites with Yang Yi Ru in a foreign land. When he learns she has only six months to live, he decides to marry her and fulfill her dream wedding. Eight days later, she mysteriously disappears, and Shi De vows not to let true love slip away again.

programme.title: Stuntman
programme.desc: Washed-up stunt director Li Sen is offered the role of action choreographer on his director friends final film. Bringing along an ambitious young stuntman, the two generations risk everything to stage a comeback. As Li Sen battles his fierce temper and past mistakes, he also strives to mend his relationship with his estranged daughter.

programme.title: Demi-Haunted ((魂魄唔齐))
programme.desc: Wan Fei is a promising Chinese Opera singer who is secretly in love with a man named Jiang Hao Feng. She wants to sing for him on stage but dies mid-song in a tragic accident. Years later, Wan Feis ghost returns, and finds that part of her spirit has been reincarnated in the form of Chor Bai, a young Chinese Opera singer. This finally allows Wan Fei to fulfill her wish (Wan Fei是一位有前途的中国歌剧歌手,他暗中爱上了一位名叫江峰的人。她想为他唱歌,但死于一场悲剧性事故。 几年后,Wan Feis的鬼魂回来了,发现她的精神的一部分已经以中国年轻歌剧歌手Chor Bai的形式转世。 这终于让Wan Fei实现了她的愿望。)

programme.title: Love Lies ((血爱成河))
programme.desc: Gynaecologist Veronica downloads a dating app for fun. Little does she know that the charming French engineer on the other end is actually a local con artist named Joe, who is a member of an online scam group. As their fake relationship unfolds, both Joes guilty conscience and Veronicas hopes intensify. (维罗妮卡(Veronica)的妇科医生下载了约会应用软件来取乐。她不知道另一端迷人的法国工程师其实是一个名叫Joe的本地骗子。 Joe是网络骗局集团的成员。 随着他们假关系的发展,Joes的内疚和Veronicas都希望加强。)

programme.title: The White Storm 3 Heaven Or Hell ((扫毒3：人在天涯))
programme.desc: Hong Kong cop Billy works undercover in Suchats drug cartel, while another undercover cop Wing successfully earns their trust in an incident and a brotherly bond is built among the three. When the police busts the syndicate, Suchat flees to the Golden Triangle with Billy and receives a tip-off about the betrayal within his circle of trust (香港警察Billy在Suchats贩毒集团卧底工作,而另一个卧底警察联翼成功地赢得了他们对一起事件的信任,并在三者之间建立起了兄弟关系。 当警察查封了黑帮时,Suchat和Billy逃到金三角,在信任圈内得到关于背叛的举报。)

programme.title: Alls Well Ends Well 2009 ((家有喜事2009))
programme.desc: Successful businesswoman Yu Chu has no chance of finding a husband with her insufferable personality, much to the consternation of her younger brother Yu Bo, who due to a curse, will fail in love until his sister gets married. Yu Bo hires a love expert, Dick, to woo his sister. Smitten at first sight, Yu Chu is not about to let Dick get away... (成功的女商人Yu Chu没有机会找到一个有她无法忍受的个性的丈夫,这在很大程度上令她弟弟Yu Bo感到惊恐,Yu Bo由于受到诅咒,在姐姐结婚之前会失去爱。Yu Bo聘请了一位爱专家Dick去追他的妹妹。一眼就发现,Yu Chu不打算让Dick逃跑。)

programme.title: A Legend ((征服世界盃：梅西的傳奇之路))
programme.desc: Archaeologist Professor Fang uncovers artifacts from a glacier expedition that resembles a jade pendant in his dream. To unveil the truth, Professor Fang leads his team to a journey into the glacier, embarking on a fantastical adventure together. (考古学家方教授在一次冰川探险中发现了一些文物,这些文物与他的梦中一颗玉冠相似。 为了揭示真相,方教授带领他的团队前往冰川,一起踏上了一场奇妙的冒险。)

programme.title: Welcome to My Side ((欢迎来到我身边))
programme.desc: After a painful breakup and a strange accident, Chen Xiao Zhou is haunted by flocks of quacking rubber ducks that only he can see. His bizarre curse disappears whenever he is with the cheerful Feng Jia Nan. As they grow closer, an absurd yet heartwarming romance blossoms, changing both their lives in unexpected ways. (陈小周在痛苦的分手和奇特的事故后,被一群只有他能看见的摇摇晃晃晃的橡皮鸭缠住了。 每当他和欢乐的冯佳南在一起时,他的怪咒就会消失。 随着他们的亲近,一个荒谬而又令人心动的浪漫花花,以出乎意料的方式改变了他们的生活。)

programme.title: Pavane For An Infant ((摇篮凡世))
programme.desc: In a conservative society, a baby hatch that never closes sparks fierce moral controversy and public backlash. Despite mounting criticism and pressure, Lai Sum, Fatimah, Kam Jie and Nuru remain steadfast in their mission to protect desperate mothers with nowhere else to turn, while offering abandoned newborns a fragile chance at life and hope. (在一个保守的社会中,一个从未关闭的婴儿孵化场引发激烈的道德争议和公众反弹。 尽管批评和压力越来越大,莱苏、法蒂玛、卡姆杰和努鲁仍然坚定地履行保护绝望母亲的使命,没有别的地方可去,同时为被遗弃的新生儿提供脆弱的生活和希望机会。)

programme.title: Iceman ((冰人))
programme.desc: Falsely accused of murder, Ming Dynasty Imperial Guard Ying is pursued by his three sworn brothers until a fierce battle leaves all four entombed in ice. Four hundred years later, they awaken in modern Hong Kong, where they must reignite their ancient feud in a world they can barely recognise. (被错误指控谋杀的明朝卫兵英被三兄弟追赶,直到一场激烈的战斗使四人被冰封。 四百年后,他们在现代香港觉醒,在那里他们必须在一个他们几乎无法辨认的世界重现其古老的世仇。)

programme.title: The Exodus ((苍穹之法芙娜 EXODUS))
programme.desc: A low-ranking cop discovers a group of women, including his superior, Madam Fang and his wife, plotting to eliminate the world of men. (一个低级警察发现了一群妇女,包括他的上司方方女士和妻子,密谋消灭男人的世界。)

programme.title: Mr Mrs Incredible ((神奇侠侣))
programme.desc: Middle-aged and retired superhero couple, Huan Gazer Man and Red Aroma Woman, settles into a contented life in a remote village. They find it hard to contain their powers though, and are bored by the uneventful life. When they hear a world martial arts contest is to be held in their village, both are itching to make their long-awaited comeback! (中年和退休的超级英雄夫妇Huan Gazer Man 和Red Aroma Women在偏远的村庄安顿下来,他们发现很难控制自己的力量,对平庸的生活感到无聊。 当他们听到世界武术比赛将在他们的村庄举行的时候,他们都渴望能够回到他们期待已久的回归!)

programme.title: Ready OR Knot ((不日成婚))
programme.desc: Guy and Heidi have been together for five years since they first met in a wedding banquet, but marriage soon becomes a challenge to their relationship. Heidi sees marriage as a testimony of their love, while Guy sees it as doomsday. Can the couple resolve their conflict? Are they ready or not? (盖伊和海迪在婚宴上第一次见面以来已经在一起五年了,但婚姻很快就成为了他们关系的挑战.海迪认为婚姻是他们爱的见证,而盖伊认为这是末日.)

programme.title: Dragon Tiger Gate ((龙虎门))
programme.desc: Adapted from a famous Hong Kong comic, Tiger Wong is ambushed after he unwittingly took the Lousha Plaque but is saved by his brother Dragon Wong. They also befriended Turbo Shek during the fight and the trio forms a brotherhood. To avenge the death of the Dragon Gate masters, they train and vow to defeat Shibumi, the leader of Lousha Clan. (龙虎王从著名的香港漫画改编而来,在无意中攻占卢沙广场后遭到伏击,但获其兄龙王救赎。 在战斗中,他们也成为Turbo Shek的朋友,三合会形成兄弟关系。 为了为龙门大师的死报仇,他们训练并发誓击败卢沙氏族领袖Shibumi。)

programme.title: Once in a Blue Moon ((望月))
programme.desc: Mei Zhens family appears to get along but harbours deep secrets. Mei Zhen is trapped in a dead-end job with a toxic boss, her brother hides his separation and their mother grapples with lingering guilt over her husbands departure years ago. As Mid-Autumn Festival approaches, can the family heal their wounds and find a way back to each other? (MeiZhens一家人似乎相处融洽,但有深奥的秘密。 MeiZhens一家人被一个有毒的老板困在死胡同中,她的兄弟隐藏了分居,他们的母亲因丈夫几年前离家而纠缠不休。 随着中秋节的临近,这个家庭能够愈合伤口,找到一条回路吗?)

programme.title: 72 Tenants of Prosperity ((72家租客))
programme.desc: Ha Kung and Shek Kin are sworn brothers, but become sworn enemies in business and every aspect of life after Pinky, the girl they love, marries Ha Kung. It is only when the property owner of both their shops wants to terminate their tenancies forty years later, that they are able to resolve the rivalry. (夏强和石坚是兄弟,但在他们爱的女孩平奇之后,他们成为商业和生活各个方面的死敌。 只有在他们两家商店的房主想在四十年后终止他们的房客时,他们才能解决竞争。)

programme.title: Home Sweet Home ((情归阿拉巴马))
programme.desc: A school bus accident kills almost everyone on board. The bus driver got injured and partially lost his memory while rescuing one of the boys. To thank the driver, the boys dad, Wang, brings him to live with the family in their basement. However, the driver soon discovers strange behaviours from the Wangs which seem to be related to the accident. (校车事故几乎使船上的所有人都丧生,公共汽车司机在救一个男孩时受伤,部分失忆。谢谢司机,父亲是男孩,王,他带着他和家人住在地下室。然而,司机很快就发现王家的奇怪行为,似乎与事故有关。)

programme.title: Little Red Sweet ((红豆))
programme.desc: A Chinese dessert shop owned by the Chang family in Kowloon City faces upheaval when the mother suffers a devastating stroke. Their daughter sacrifices her dream of becoming a flight attendant to help keep the family business alive, but tensions rise as she clashes with her father. Can they find a way to overcome their struggles and remain united? (由于母亲遭受了严重的中风,在科隆市的长家族拥有的中国甜点店面临了动荡.他们的女儿牺牲了成为空姐的梦想,以帮助维持家庭业务,但随着她和父亲的冲突,紧张局势日益升高.)

programme.title: Behind the Shadows ((阴守忍者))
programme.desc: Private detective Ouyang uncovers his wifes betrayal during an investigation. Reeling from the shock, he abandons a missing person case. Soon after, the missing person turns up dead. Inspector Chen suspects a serial killer may be at large. Now drawn back into the case, Ouyang must use his skills to stop the killer before another life is taken. (欧阳二等兵侦探在调查期间发现了妻子的背叛。他因惊吓而放弃了一个失踪人员案件。不久之后,失踪的人就死了。陈督察怀疑一个连环杀手可能逍遥法外。 欧阳必须用他的能力在另一个人被杀死之前阻止凶手。)

programme.title: Victims ((法律与秩序：特殊受害者))
programme.desc: A ruthless Kuala Lumpur high school student kills his classmate, exposing the contrasting struggles of the victims mother and the murderers mother as they uncover their sons hidden secrets, while inching closer to a heartbreaking truth. (一位无情的吉隆坡高中生杀死同学, 揭露受害者母亲与杀人犯母亲在揭发儿子隐藏秘密时,)

programme.title: Wild City ((野性新加坡))
programme.desc: A cop-turned-bar-owner befriends a drunken woman at closing hours and finds himself pursued by her former lover and the thugs he employs. The chase turns deadly when the bar owners deadbeat brother and a suitcase full of cash enter the picture. (当酒吧老板的死党兄弟和装满现金的手提箱进入照片中时,追逐就会变得致命。)

programme.title: The Last Dance ((最后的舞动))
programme.desc: Amid the recession caused by the pandemic, debt-ridden wedding planner, Sheng, finds a lifeline as he transitions into a funeral planner. His unconventional approach leads to unexpected success, and his attitude toward his career and life is transformed after being inspired by the respected Master Wen. (在这场大流行病引发的经济衰退中,负债累累的婚礼策划者沈成在他向丧葬计划者过渡的过程中找到了一条生命线。 他的非常规方法导致出乎意料的成功,他对他的职业生涯和生活的态度在受到尊敬的温大师的启发后发生了转变。)

programme.title: Tiger Wolf Rabbit ((浴火之路))
programme.desc: Three devastated parents, pushed to the edge by the abduction of their children, forge a fierce alliance in the barren deserts. Driven by fury and grief, they embark on a lawless, violent crusade to hunt down a brutal trafficking syndicate. Can they shatter the criminal ring and bring their children home alive? (在愤怒和悲痛的驱使下,他们开始一场无序的暴力斗争,以追击残酷的贩运集团。 他们能摧毁犯罪团伙,让孩子活着回家吗?)

programme.title: House of Traps ((House of 青出于蓝s))
programme.desc: An evil prince has hidden the stolen imperial treasures in a house filled with booby-trapped blades. Amid plasma-spurting attacks, heroes and rogues try to uncover the deadly secrets of the house... (邪恶的王子把被盗的帝国宝藏藏在一个充满了诱杀刀片的房子里。 在等离子清除攻击中,英雄和流氓试图揭开房子的致命秘密...)

programme.title: The Mighty One ((后院活宝))
programme.desc: Lung seeks five volumes of a renowned Kung Fu manual to gain invincibility. When he believes a martial arts school master possesses the volumes, he kills him and his daughter but leaves behind a young brother and sister. Years later, Lung loses two volumes and starts another bloody hunt but each attempt is interrupted by two mysterious warriors... (龙龙寻找五卷著名的功夫手册,以获得不可战胜力。当他相信武术师傅拥有这本书时,他杀死他和他的女儿,但留下一个弟弟妹妹。 几年后,龙龙输了两卷,又开始了另一次血腥狩猎,但每次尝试都被两个神秘的战士打断...)

programme.title: Holy Flame of the Martial World ((武林圣火令))
programme.desc: Yin Tian Chous parents were killed over a pair of flame-shaped blades. He and his sister were rescued, raised, and trained separately by a hero and a villain, each inheriting one of the blades. Sworn enemies at first, they eventually uncover their true identities and join forces to avenge their parents deaths. (天的父母被一对火焰状刀子杀害.他和他的姐姐被英雄和恶棍分别救援,抚养和训练,每个继承了刀子中的一个.起初他们宣誓敌人,最终揭露了他们的真实身份,并联合起来报复父母的死亡.)

programme.title: The Purple Shell ((紫贝壳))
programme.desc: Hui and Ha are stuck in their unhappy marriages and are attracted to each other when they meet at a party. In one of their beach strolls, Ha picks up a purple shell and gives it to Hui as a memento. When Huis husband finds out about them, he hurts Hui and causes her to become seriously ill, while also blackmails Ha. How will this love story end? (Hui和Ha被困在他们不愉快的婚姻中,当他们在聚会上见面时互相吸引。在他们的一个海滩漫步中,Ha拿起一个紫色的贝壳,把它交给Hui作为纪念物。当Hui的丈夫发现这些壳壳时,他伤害了Hui,让她病得很重,同时也敲诈Ha。这个爱情故事会如何结束呢?)

programme.title: Shaolin Rescuers ((街市英雄))
programme.desc: Hong Xi Guan of Shaolin is chased and wounded by a martial arts scum who took refuge in the Qing court. He is saved and healed by friends from the wet market and they hide Hong in a bean curd shop to protect him. However, Hongs enemy finds him and ambushes him at the shop, hoping to capture Hong and all his friends. (少林的洪西关被逃到清廷的武术败类追赶受伤,他被来自湿市的朋友救治,他们把洪光藏在豆腐店里保护他,但香港敌人发现他,在店里伏击他,希望抓住洪光和他所有的朋友。)

programme.title: Princess Iron Fan (铁扇公主)
programme.desc: Tang San Zang and his disciples are halted by the Flaming Mountains, where only Princess Iron Fans fan can quench the fire. Refused help by the Bull Demon King and his wife, Sun Wukong must outwit them to obtain it. After crossing, they fall into a trap set by the White Bone Demon sisters, and Wukong must use his powers to save his master. (唐三藏及其门徒被火烈山阻挡,只有铁扇公主的粉丝才能扑灭火焰。 被公牛魔王及其妻子拒绝的孙武康必须赶过他们才能得到火烈山。 穿越后,他们落入白骨魔姐妹的陷阱,而武贡必须利用他的力量来救他的主人。)

programme.title: Opium And The Kung-Fu Master ((洪拳大师))
programme.desc: Tie Qiao San, head of the Ten Guangdong Tigers, is an honourable master with many disciples. As opium becomes popular among the nobles, Tie starts taking it and gradually harms his body. When an opium houses owner defeats Tie in a fight and he is only saved from being killed by his disciple, Tie vows to quit opium and get back on his feet. (泰广东虎队长铁桥三是一位有众多门徒的光荣大师。 随着鸦片在贵族中越来越受欢迎,铁桥开始吸食鸦片并逐渐伤害他的身体。 当鸦片屋主在战斗中击败铁桥,他只能免于被门徒杀害时,铁桥发誓戒除鸦片并重新站起来。)

programme.title: Diary Of A Lady-killer ((猎人))
programme.desc: Tycoon Zhou is a playboy who is engaged to be married, but that did not keep him from working his charms on as many ladies as he can. He keeps a diary about his romantic escapades and soon, the women with whom he has been intimate with are being murdered one by one. Zhou becomes the number one suspect by the police but is the killer someone else? (Tycoon Zhou是一个订婚的花花公子,但这并不阻止他尽可能多地对女士施展魅力。 他有一本关于他浪漫的幻想的日记,很快,他所亲密的女子就被一对一地杀害。 周成为警方的头号嫌疑犯,但凶手是另一个人吗?)

programme.title: Brothers Five ((兄弟 Five))
programme.desc: The five Kao brothers, separated since birth, are unaware that the master of Teng Lung Manor has killed their father. All five however, vow to defeat the vicious gangsters at the manor due to their bullying ways. After reuniting and with much discipline and hard work, the Kaos are prepared to face Lung and his gang. (5个自出生以来分离的考兄弟不知道邓龙庄主杀死了他们的父亲。 然而,所有5个兄弟都因为欺凌而发誓打败庄园里的恶棍。 在重新团结、纪律严明和辛勤工作之后,高山准备面对龙及其帮派。)

programme.title: Lovers Blades ((神经大侠))
programme.desc: The Lovers Blades, a pair of invincible weapons, are to be delivered to the Qing Emperor. However, they accidentally fell into the hands of Xiao Zhong Hui and Yuan Guan Nan, so Imperial Chief Zhuo Tian Xiong hunts them down for the blades. As the battle begins, the secret of the blades are also revealed. (将把一对不可战胜的武器 " 刀锋 " 交给清皇,但意外落入小中惠和元光南之手,于是皇上卓天雄就把他们捉拿下来,在战斗开始时,刀剑的秘密也暴露出来。)

programme.title: The Master Of Kung Fu ((南拳蔡李佛))
programme.desc: The famous kung fu master Wong Fei Hung teaches martial arts in Guangdong. A vicious gangster plots to harm Wongs disciples and frames him for robbery and murder. Wong has to fight against the culprit to prove his own innocence and take revenge for his disciples. (著名的功夫大师黄飞鸿在广东教武术。 一个恶毒的黑帮阴谋要伤害黄徒门徒,陷害他抢劫和谋杀。 王王必须对抗罪犯以证明他无罪并报复门徒。)

programme.title: The Merry Wife ((娃娃夫人))
programme.desc: A 17-year old schoolgirl marries her 35-year-old teacher. Comedy ensues when they attempt to keep their relationship a secret despite being in the same school. When they discover unwanted suitors going after their other halves, jealousy threatens to expose their marriage any minute! (一位17岁的女学生娶了她35岁的老师。喜剧在他们试图将关系秘密化时出现,尽管他们在同一所学校。 当他们发现那些不想要的求婚者追求另一半时,嫉妒有可能随时暴露他们的婚姻!)

programme.title: Swift Sword ((情侠追风剑))
programme.desc: A righteous swordsman, Bai Yi Pang, seeks revenge on an evil clan but is crippled after being beaten up by them. Years later, a young man encounters Bai who is hiding in a cave. Bai decides to teach this determined young man his Swift Sword skills so that he can help Bai take revenge on the evil clan. (一个正义的剑客白义邦(Bai Yi Pang)向一个邪恶的部族复仇,但在被他们殴打后残废。 数年后,一个年轻人遇见了藏在洞穴里的白白。 白白决定教这个坚定的年轻人他的斯威夫特剑术,以便帮助白白报复邪恶的部族。)

programme.title: Human Lanterns ((人皮灯笼))
programme.desc: Zhao was once defeated by Long in a duel. 7 years later, Long asks Zhao to make a unique lantern on his behalf to win the lantern contest, while Zhao plans for revenge. When Longs wife suddenly disappears one day and he hears about the story of human lanterns, Long suspects Zhao may be involved in the incident (7年后,龙赵龙在决斗中被龙龙击败,龙龙求赵王代表他做个独特的灯笼,以赢得灯笼比赛,而赵王则计划报复。 当长妻突然消失,听到人灯的故事,长妻可能卷入其中。)

programme.title: The Daredevils ((The 夜魔侠s))
programme.desc: Corrupt general Wang Li assumes power by killing his superior. The son of the murdered superior befriends four street performers called The Venoms, and they help him take revenge by posing as government officials offering a peace token to the corrupt general. When Wang arrives at a warehouse, he is ambushed by the Venoms! (腐败的王利将军通过杀害上司而掌权。 被谋杀的上司的儿子与四位街头表演者建立了朋友关系,他们称毒瘾为“毒瘾 ” ( The Venoms ), 他们帮助他复仇,假扮政府官员向腐败的上将提供和平象征。 当王上将抵达仓库时,他被毒瘾伏击!)

programme.title: Two Champions of Shaolin ((少林与武当))
programme.desc: Set in the Qing Dynasty, the Shaolin clan wants to overthrow Qing and restore the Ming Dynasty, while the Wudang clan is backed by the Qing government. The two renowned clans eventually set themselves up against each other, and a series of vicious fighting has just begun (在清朝中,少林氏族想推翻清清,恢复明朝,而武当族则得到清政府的支持。 两大知名氏族最终相互对立,一系列恶战刚刚开始。)

programme.title: Moonlight Serenade ((月光小夜曲))
programme.desc: A sweet inn-keepers daughter is witness to a perverted rape, leading to more danger than most romantic dramas can handle. Can her true love rescue her in time? For this movie, the moonlight serenade is the sound of suspense, leading to more danger than most romantic dramas can handle. (爱情的故事,是关于一个爱情的故事,是关于一个爱情的故事,是关于一个爱情的故事.)

programme.title: Brotherhood ((龙争虎斗))
programme.desc: Liu Da Jiang, a naive young man, is betrayed and hunted by his sworn brothers after a gold robbery goes wrong. Surviving against the odds, he gains the favour of a gang leader and embarks on a path of revenge with bodyguard Jin Yan. As rival gangs clash and feelings emerge, a violent underworld showdown becomes inevitable. (刘大江是一个天真的年轻人,在一次金盗出错后被他的宣誓兄弟背叛和猎杀。 他幸免于险,赢得了黑帮领袖的青睐,与保镖金燕一起走上了复仇之路。 随着敌对帮派的冲突和感情的出现,一场暴力的地下大决战不可避免。)

programme.title: Mad Monkey Kung Fu ((疯猴))
programme.desc: Master Chen was an esteemed Monkey Kung Fu master, until he is framed and crippled by a ruthless villain and ends up becoming a wandering artiste. When Chen meets a young man, Little Monkey, on the streets, he decides to teach him all his monkey kung fu moves. Both men eventually team up to avenge Chens past insult. (陈先生是一位受尊敬的子功夫大师,直到他被一个无情的恶棍入了架子和了,最终成为一个流浪艺术家.当陈在街上遇到一个年轻人,小子,他决定教他他的子功夫运动.)

programme.title: The Thunderbolt Fist ((霹雳拳))
programme.desc: A vicious Japanese judo expert wants to prove that Chinese are the sick people of Asia and sets out to sabotage and kill the best martial artists in dangerous tournaments. To save his son from this, the head of Ping Pai Boxing Institute sends him to the mountains to learn the powerful Thunderbolt Fist technique from master fighter, Red Butterfly. (一位恶毒的日本柔道专家想证明中国人是亚洲病态人士,并准备在危险的锦标赛中破坏和杀害最优秀的武术艺术家。 为了救他的儿子,平派拳击学会会长派他到山上学习大拳手红蝴蝶的强力雷波特拳法。)

programme.title: Blue Skies ((碧云天))
programme.desc: A young singer Hsiao Yun becomes an overnight sensation after standing in for another singer at the eleventh hour. Her success comes at a heavy price however, when her love with a pianist suffers. On top of this, Hsiao Yun must also deal with the unwanted affections from an influential backer of her show. (云在11点时替换另一位歌手,成为一夜之间一场轰动.她的成功却以高昂的价格来,因为她对钢琴家的爱情受到了痛苦.)

programme.title: The Young Avenger ((小毒龙))
programme.desc: Liu seeks out Li to avenge his brothers death and loses an arm in the fight, vowing revenge ten years later. Li dies after asking his sister to send his daughter Bao Zhu to learn the Dragon Sword skill to avenge his death. Bao Zhu grows up to become a skilled swordswoman and meets Liu for the planned duel with her cousin Chen. Can she defeat Liu? (刘晓华想为兄弟们的死报仇,在战斗中失去一只手臂,十年后发誓复仇。李明华要求姐姐送女儿宝珠去学龙剑之术,为他报仇。 保珠成长成为一名熟练的武士,与刘晓华的表弟陈氏相遇,计划进行决斗。 她能打败刘晓珠吗?)

programme.title: Sons Of Good Earth ((大地儿女))
programme.desc: This is an epic tale set during the time of the Sino-Japanese war. A painter Yu saves a young girl, Lotus, who is being sold to a brothel. They fall in love, get married and settled in to a peaceful life. However, their life is soon shattered by the Japanese invasion and the brutal regime that follows... (这是中日战争时期的史诗故事。 一位画家于优拯救了一位年轻女孩Lotus,Lotus,她正被卖给妓院。她们坠入爱河,结婚并安顿下来过上平静的生活。然而,他们的生活很快被日本的入侵和随后的残暴政权所摧毁。)

programme.title: New Tales of the Flying Fox ((新飞狐外传))
programme.desc: In a great rendition of The Silver Fox and Legend of the Fox comes this exciting adventure, where the only thing between the clan leaders and certain death is Hui Ying-hung. (在银狐和传奇传奇的传说 伟大的传说中 福狐来了这个激动人心的冒险)

programme.title: Inside The Forbidden City ((解密紫禁城))
programme.desc: Justice Bao discovers that Consort Lis new born son was swapped at birth and that she was expelled from the palace by Empress Liu twenty years ago. He sets Eunuch Guo up to confess his conspiracy with the Empress. Empress Liu is convicted for her act and Consort Li finally reunites with her son who is now the Emperor. (法官发现李新生儿在出生时被换换,女皇20年前驱逐她出宫殿.他让女士承认与女皇的阴谋.女皇因她的行为被定罪,李女士最终与她现在的儿子重聚.)

programme.title: Kavan
programme.desc: A TV journalist goes against the orders of his corrupt and dishonest boss and helps a group of youngsters in their fight against a pesticide factory.

programme.title: Mom
programme.desc: Devaki has a stepdaughter Arya. She is a caring mother. One unfortunate night Arya is brutally attacked. When the justice system fails them, she goes to great lengths to find justice for her daughter.

programme.title: Officer On Duty
programme.desc: A demoted inspector investigates a counterfeit jewelry ring and becomes stuck in a deadly crime web that endangers his life and testshiscourage.

programme.title: Family Padam
programme.desc: A middle-class family who can afford movie tickets dreams of making a film to fulfill their younger sons wish to rediscover himself, facing grave challenges.

programme.title: Stalin
programme.desc: Stalin is deeply moved by the suicide of a girl with physical disabilities. As a result, he devises a formula of extending unconditional help to those who need it to establish peace.

programme.title: Thumbaa
programme.desc: Hari and Umapathy, two painters, meet Varsha, a wildlife photographer, while working in a forest. Soon, they team up to stop a corrupt officer from capturing a tiger, Thumbaa.

programme.title: Cold Case
programme.desc: When a skull is found in a package, ACP Sathyajith is assigned to identify the victim and catch the killer. Meanwhile, a journalist haunted by a spirit investigates the mystery.

programme.title: Bhagavanth Kesari
programme.desc: Bhagavanth Kesari encourages his late friends daughter to join the army while confronting a powerful man from his past who stands in their way.

programme.title: Madha Yaanai Koottam
programme.desc: Prithivi kill his uncles son unfortunately. So his uncle and other family members take revenge on him.

programme.title: Free Ticket
programme.desc: The host presents a curated compilation of hit songs and memorable snippets from the most popular and trending Tamil movies, celebrating the best of Tamil cinema.

programme.title: Akhanda
programme.desc: Akhanda, a devotee of Lord Shiva, protects Murali Krishna from Varadarajulus evil scheme. The story unfolds with divine intervention, bringing justice in a captivating tale of righteousness.

programme.title: Vaayai Moodi Pesavum
programme.desc: The people of the Panimalai hill station are in trouble as the government has put a ban on speaking to control the spread of the dumb-flu that spreads only through talking.

programme.title: V
programme.desc: When aliens land on Earth claiming to help humanity, they seem friendly at first. But as they integrate into society, their hidden agenda starts to unfold.

programme.title: Maamanithan
programme.desc: A humble auto driver, desperate to improve the standard of education for his children, convinces a real estate agent that he will help him sell all his plots.

programme.title: Sethupathi
programme.desc: Sethupathi, a tough police officer, investigates the murder of an inspector. His findings lead to the arrest of Vathiyar, an influential man in Madurai, but put his life, career and family at risk.

programme.title: Brother
programme.desc: A young man struggles to find his place after moving in with his sister and her in-laws.

programme.title: Ace
programme.desc: Kannan moves to a foreign country seeking life, but gets dragged into shark circle. A heist turns hope into a curse, forcing him to outsmart fate.

programme.desc: Robson joins Carol Smillie in the Scottish Highlands for a day of outdoor adventures. At Loch Earne, they try a traditional boat known as a coracle and then make Iron Age-style clay pots. (Robson与苏格兰高地的Carol Smillie一起参加一天的户外冒险。在Loch Ene,他们尝试了一条传统船,称为铁器,然后制造铁器时代式的粘土锅。)

programme.title: Sue Perkins Into Alaska (苏·佩金斯到阿拉斯加)

programme.title: Engineering Repurposed ((牛来))
programme.desc: Attend a concert in a hall that soars 50 metres into the sky, then dig 30 metres underground to explore a revolutionary farm. (在一个50米高的音乐厅上参加音乐会,然后在地下挖掘30米,)

programme.title: Planet Earth ((地球脉动))

programme.desc: Join Amanda on a white knuckle bush-whacking adventure to rescue a waterbuck caught by a poachers snare. Meanwhile, the centers resident hyena is treated for flea bitten ears and Alma gets a mysterious late night monkey delivery. (加入Amanda的白拳灌木丛冒险活动,拯救被偷猎者偷猎的水桶。 与此同时,土狼收容中心被跳蚤咬耳朵治疗,而Alma却在深夜被神秘的猴子送来。)

programme.title: Baby Animals ((动物宝宝))
programme.desc: Elephants, gorillas, rhinos, and bison are among the largest and most imposing land-dwelling mammals, but they all start out as helpless infants. See how babies from each species find their way to becoming giants. (大象、大猩猩、犀牛和野牛是最大的、最强制性的陆上栖息哺乳动物,但它们都是无助的婴儿。 看看每个物种的婴儿如何成为巨人。)

programme.title: Malawi Wildlife Rescue ((马拉威野生拯救队))
programme.desc: Watch as the Lilongwe Wildlife team try to release two serval cats into the wild. One escapes and returns injured. Will their release be successful? A new baby vervet arrives in critical condition, and a giant owl flies to freedom. (看着利隆圭野生动物团队试图释放两只保护猫。 一只猫逃出,然后受伤。 释放它们是否成功? 一个新的婴儿动脉在危急条件下到达,一只巨型猫头鹰飞向自由。)

programme.title: Big Cat Country ((狮子王国))
programme.desc: The lions of the Nomad pride rampage deep into the heart of the MK prides territory, scattering its members and coming dangerously close to the five new MK cubs. Meanwhile, the Hollywoods are recovering, and Avas survival skills are still intact. (游牧民族的骄傲狂妄的狮子们深入了MK骄傲的领地中心,分散了其成员,危险地接近了5个新的MK幼崽。 与此同时,好莱坞正在恢复,阿瓦斯的生存技能依然未变。)

programme.title: Superbeast ((超级野兽))
programme.desc: Bask in the awe-inspiring strength of the animal kingdoms most powerful creatures. Smash through rock-hard termite mounds with silverback gorillas, see jaguars that can crush caiman skulls, then head to the ocean to witness orcas hunting in packs. (在动物王国最强大的动物国的强大力量中,巴斯克(Bask)最强大。 以银背大猩猩的岩石硬石白蚁猎犬,用银背大猩猩击打,看到能够粉碎caiman头骨的美洲虎,然后前往海洋见证猎豹群。)

programme.title: Superbeast ((超级野兽))
programme.desc: Hit the gas with Earths fastest animal athletes. Watch death adders strike in the blink of an eye, do airborne assassinations with peregrine falcons, catch a quick meal with chameleons, and face breakneck G-forces as gannets dive-bomb their prey. (随着地球最快的动物运动员的击球, 观看死亡鱼在瞬间袭击, 用鱼进行空中暗杀, 与马龙一起快速吃饭,)

programme.title: Super Shark Highway ((无敌猛鲨（2011年美国电影）))
programme.desc: Track a pregnant shark along the Great Barrier Reef and see if she leads a team of scientists to her hidden pupping ground. Then search for signs of mating along the southern coast that could reveal a very shy female megashark in search of a partner. (跟踪大堡礁沿岸的一头怀孕的鲨鱼,看看她是否带领一组科学家到她隐藏的抽水场。 然后在南部海岸寻找交配的迹象,这些迹象可能暴露出一个非常害羞的雌性巨型巨型巨型猎物,以寻找伴侣。)

programme.title: Rooted ((生命之树))
programme.desc: The Namaqua Rock Fig Tree stands rooted on the slope of a rocky hill in Namaqualand, South Africa. It is the ultimate survivor, able to withstand the unforgiving conditions in a landscape facing ever rising temperatures and less and less rainfall each year. (在南非纳马夸兰的一个岩石山坡上扎根的Namaqua Rock Fig树站着。 它是终极生存者,能够在每年面临气温不断上升和降雨量越来越少的风景中忍受无情的环境条件。)

programme.title: Malawi Wildlife Rescue ((马拉威野生拯救队))
programme.desc: Join Amanda on a white knuckle bush-whacking adventure to rescue a waterbuck caught by a poachers snare. Meanwhile, the centers resident hyena is treated for flea bitten ears and Alma gets a mysterious late night monkey delivery. (加入Amanda的白拳灌木丛冒险活动,拯救被偷猎者偷猎的水桶。 与此同时,土狼收容中心被跳蚤咬耳朵治疗,而Alma却在深夜被神秘的猴子送来。)

programme.title: Jaguar Journals (捷日志)
programme.desc: Watch the Onafari team get to know Aroeira, their newly collared female, and take a peek at Auroras cub, Apolo. Continue to track Badalo, who has moved deeper into the flooded forest, where he puts Lizzies game-changing research in jeopardy. (观察Onfari 团队了解了Aroeira, 也就是他们新被囚禁的女性Aroeira, 并查看了Apolo的Auroras 幼崽。 继续追踪Badalo,他已经深入到洪水泛滥的森林,在那里他将利兹改变游戏的研究置于危险之中。)

programme.title: Superbeast ((超级野兽))
programme.desc: Bask in the awe-inspiring strength of the animal kingdoms most powerful creatures. Smash through rock-hard termite mounds with silverback gorillas, see jaguars that can crush caiman skulls, then head to the ocean to witness orcas hunting in packs. (在动物王国最强大的动物国的强大力量中,巴斯克(Bask)最强大。 以银背大猩猩的岩石硬石白蚁猎犬,用银背大猩猩击打,看到能够粉碎caiman头骨的美洲虎,然后前往海洋见证猎豹群。)

programme.title: Superbeast ((超级野兽))
programme.desc: Hit the gas with Earths fastest animal athletes. Watch death adders strike in the blink of an eye, do airborne assassinations with peregrine falcons, catch a quick meal with chameleons, and face breakneck G-forces as gannets dive-bomb their prey. (随着地球最快的动物运动员的击球, 观看死亡鱼在瞬间袭击, 用鱼进行空中暗杀, 与马龙一起快速吃饭,)

programme.title: Super Shark Highway ((无敌猛鲨（2011年美国电影）))
programme.desc: Track a pregnant shark along the Great Barrier Reef and see if she leads a team of scientists to her hidden pupping ground. Then search for signs of mating along the southern coast that could reveal a very shy female megashark in search of a partner. (跟踪大堡礁沿岸的一头怀孕的鲨鱼,看看她是否带领一组科学家到她隐藏的抽水场。 然后在南部海岸寻找交配的迹象,这些迹象可能暴露出一个非常害羞的雌性巨型巨型巨型猎物,以寻找伴侣。)

programme.title: Rooted ((生命之树))
programme.desc: The Namaqua Rock Fig Tree stands rooted on the slope of a rocky hill in Namaqualand, South Africa. It is the ultimate survivor, able to withstand the unforgiving conditions in a landscape facing ever rising temperatures and less and less rainfall each year. programme.title: Baby Animals ((动物宝宝))
programme.desc: Not all infants in the animal kingdom get to have a good mother. But these are the stories of the lucky ones, from a ring-tailed lemur who learns everything from its mom to a tiny orangutan that receives a constant supply of motherly cuddles. (并不是动物王国的所有婴儿都能有一个好母亲。但这些都是幸运者的故事,从一个从母亲那里学到一切的环尾狐猴,到一个不断得到母亲抱抱的小猩猩。)

programme.title: Amazing Animal Friends ((Amazing Animal 老友记))
programme.desc: This episode of Amazing Animal Friends features a duck that wont go in the water without a ride from her pooch pal, an elephant that thinks shes a buffalo, and a herd of cows that adopt an orphaned deer. (这部"惊人的动物朋友"的集中,有一个子,没有她的朋友带她去水里,)

programme.title: Secret Life Of The Tasmanian Devil ((Secret 终生惩戒 Of The Tasmanian Devil))
programme.desc: For Tasmanian devils, dominance is the name of the game during mating season. Meet males who fight for the right to pass on their genes, and learn about the violent, noisy etiquette of these carnivorous marsupials mealtime. (对于塔斯马尼亚魔鬼来说,支配性是交配季节游戏的名称。 与那些为传承基因的权利而奋斗的男性见面,并了解这些肉食性肉食的饮食时间的暴力、吵闹的礼仪。)

programme.title: Secret Life Of The Tasmanian Devil ((Secret 终生惩戒 Of The Tasmanian Devil))
programme.desc: Tasmanian Devils might have the most infamous reputations of any of the countrys marsupials, but these spirited scrappers also have another side. Theyre committed parents and heroic defenders of their pouch-reared young. (塔斯马尼亚恶魔可能拥有任何国家最臭名昭著的名声,但这些虔诚的碎尸者也有另一面。 他们是忠诚的父母,也是他们年轻时的英雄捍卫者,他们都是靠邮袋长大的年轻人。)

programme.title: Dawn to Dusk ((神奇动物的一天))
programme.desc: Live through a sunny tropical September day with creatures from Polynesia to the Indonesian archipelago. See how the sun affects the movement, feeding habits, and mating rituals of everything from tiny zooplankton to whale sharks. (从波利尼西亚到印度尼西亚群岛的动物们生活在阳光明媚的热带9月的一天中。 看看太阳如何影响从小浮游动物到鲸鲨等一切事物的移动、饮食习惯和交配仪式。)

programme.title: Dawn To Dusk ((神奇动物的一天))
programme.desc: Celebrate the first day of spring with Aussie creatures looking for either a dinner or a date. From the kangaroos in the grasslands to the koalas in the trees to the freshwater crocodiles, they hunt for food or fight for breeding rights. (庆祝春天的第一天,与澳洲生物一起寻找晚餐或约会。 从草原上的袋鼠到树上的考拉,到淡水鳄鱼,它们都在寻找食物或争夺繁殖权。)

programme.title: Dawn To Dusk ((神奇动物的一天))
programme.desc: Meet the unique primates and reptiles searching for water and dodging predators, from ring-tailed lemurs in the east coast rainforests to tiny brown leaf chameleons, in this land of extreme climate variations and habitats. (与独特的灵长类动物和爬行动物相遇 寻找水和猎食动物 从东海岸雨林的环尾狐猴 到棕色小叶变色龙)

programme.title: Dawn To Dusk ((神奇动物的一天))
programme.desc: Visit one of the most arid and hottest parts of the world to discover how dhub lizards and dromedary camels adapted to withstand the intense conditions. Then move into the more moderate southern mountains, where rare hyrax and chameleons forage. (访问世界上最干旱和最热闹的地区之一,以了解dhub蜥蜴和热带骆驼是如何适应恶劣条件的。 然后进入较温和的南部山区,那里有稀有的hyrax和色素饲料。)

programme.title: Tales From Zambia ((赞比亚传奇))
programme.desc: Africa is a continent filled with unique and extraordinary creatures whose lives are shaped by millions of years of evolution. Africa is also the birthplace of humankind. We traveled alongside the continents animals on our own journey of evolution, yet intelligence took us on a very different path. Our curiosity led to questions about the world around us which were answered through stories, myths and legends. (非洲是一个充满独特和非凡的动物的大陆,其生命是由数百万年的进化过程塑造的。非洲也是人类的诞生地。我们在自己的进化历程上与各大陆的动物一起旅行,然而智慧使我们走上了一条完全不同的道路。我们的好奇心引出了关于我们周围世界的问题,这些问题通过故事、神话和传说得到了解答。)

programme.title: Tales From Zambia ((赞比亚传奇))
programme.desc: Chilema is an Elephant with half a trunk losing the tip to a poachers snare. It was intended to catch antelope for bushmeat. But the snares indiscriminate nature means other animals often fall foul of them, with devastating results. Chilema is now having to adapt to life without an elephants most important appendage. She must learn how to eat, drink and also take a mud bath to ensure her survival. With the added challenge of the harsh dry season, Chilema is fighting against the odds to survive. (智利是一只大象,半个树干将小便输给偷猎者,目的是捕捉蚂蚁作为灌木。但是,滥杀滥伤自然意味着其他动物经常与它们发生染污,并产生毁灭性后果。智利现在必须适应没有最重要的大象附着物的生活。她必须学会如何吃饭、喝酒和洗泥浴,以确保她的生存。由于严酷的旱季的附加挑战,智利正在对抗生存的机率。)

programme.title: Tales From Zambia ((赞比亚传奇))
programme.desc: Trees are Africas oldest residents, and each has its own strategy for surviving the dry season. The sausage tree and the fig tree ride-out seasonal extremes, to provide food and shelter for struggling animals in the lean times. In return animals help these trees to reproduce by pollinating their flowers and dispersing their seed. African trees promote life, and form the backbone of one of Earths most precious ecosystems. (非洲最古老的树木是非洲最古老的居民,每棵树都有自己在旱季生存的战略。 香肠树和无花果树的季节性极端,为在贫瘠时期挣扎的动物提供食物和栖身之处。 作为回报,动物通过授粉花朵和分散种子来帮助这些树木繁殖。 非洲树木促进生命,并成为地球上最宝贵的生态系统之一的支柱。)

programme.title: Super Shark Highway ((无敌猛鲨（2011年美国电影）))
programme.desc: Embark on a dangerous tagging mission in South Australia that will show what sharks eat and why they gather in feeding hot spots. Then head north as a team chases tiger, bull, and hammerhead sharks and outfits one with a 360-degree dorsal camera. (在南澳大利亚州执行一个危险的拖拖任务,该任务将展示鲨鱼吃什么,为什么它们聚集在热点地区。 然后,当一个团队向北追赶老虎、公牛和锤头鲨鱼,并装配一个带有360度双角相机的鲨鱼。)

programme.title: Super Shark Highway ((无敌猛鲨（2011年美国电影）))
programme.desc: Track a pregnant shark along the Great Barrier Reef and see if she leads a team of scientists to her hidden pupping ground. Then search for signs of mating along the southern coast that could reveal a very shy female megashark in search of a partner. (跟踪大堡礁沿岸的一头怀孕的鲨鱼,看看她是否带领一组科学家到她隐藏的抽水场。 然后在南部海岸寻找交配的迹象,这些迹象可能暴露出一个非常害羞的雌性巨型巨型巨型猎物,以寻找伴侣。)

programme.title: Evolution Earth ((地球演化實錄))
programme.desc: Trek to the planets quickly melting poles, where animals are giving scientists clues about our future existence. Learn how the movements of polar bears, penguins, and other arctic creatures could help humans map and prevent global warming. (探索行星迅速融化的极地,动物们正在向科学家们提供有关我们未来生存的线索。 了解北极熊、企鹅和其他北极生物的移动如何帮助人类绘制地图并防止全球变暖。)

programme.title: Evolution Earth ((地球演化實錄))
programme.desc: Explore one of Earths most vital but overlooked habitats and learn how grasslands could slow climate change by soaking up more carbon than forests do. Meet key species, such as bison and pumas, that could restore this resource and heal our planet. (探索一个最重要的但却被忽视的地球,并学习草原如何通过吸收比森林更多的碳来减缓气候变化。 与野牛和美洲狮等能够恢复这一资源并治愈地球的关键物种相遇。)

programme.title: Wild Science (野科学)
programme.desc: Trace the lions rise from prehistoric predator to modern ruler as science reveals the battles, bonds, and brutal survival strategies that have shaped this iconic African hunter. Get swept up in the drama of lion society and high-risk hunts. (追寻狮子从史前掠食者上升到现代统治者,因为科学揭示了塑造了这个具有象征意义的非洲猎人的战斗、纽带和残酷的生存策略。 被狮子社会和高风险狩猎的剧情扫荡一空。)

programme.title: Wild Science (野科学)
programme.desc: Confront the oceans most versatile and formidable predator. Learn about the biological advantages that helped this prehistoric species survive multiple mass extinctions, then get awed by the relentless hunting skills of bull sharks. (了解这些生物的优势 帮助这些史前物种生存下来 经历了多次大规模灭绝 并被公牛鲨鱼无情的捕猎技巧所迷惑)

programme.title: Planet Shark ((鲨鱼星球))
programme.desc: Stalk the seas with sharks as they hunt using heightened senses and killer instincts. Watch a whitetip reef shark put its electrical sensors to work finding its preys heartbeat, and the pelagic thresher shark stun its quarry with its whiplike tail. (鲨鱼在捕猎时用高温感官和杀手本能跟踪海洋。 观察白礁鲨鱼用电感应器探寻猎物心跳,中上层鲨鱼用鞭子尾巴捕捉采石场。)

programme.title: Planet Shark ((鲨鱼星球))
programme.desc: Navigate the oceans vast distances, depths, and darkness with nomadic sharks that thrive in the blue emptiness. Meet a lone blue shark traversing stormy Atlantic seas, and hundreds of hammerheads returning to their Pacific island breeding ground. (带着在蓝空中繁衍的游牧鲨鱼在远方、深处和黑暗的海洋中航行。 遇到一只独身的蓝鲨横渡大西洋,数以百计的锤头返回太平洋岛屿繁殖地。)

programme.title: Planet Shark ((鲨鱼星球))
programme.desc: Follow a host of sharks with extraordinary abilities that allow them to thrive in the most adverse conditions around the globe. Observe nearly blind Greenland sharks made for life in freezing Arctic waters, and another species that can walk on land. (格陵兰的鲨鱼在冰冻的北极水域中生存着,还有另一种可以在陆地上行走的物种。)

programme.title: Homes Gone Wild
programme.desc: Jack tours the former home of Hollywood royalty, lands in Gold Rush territory, and travels to Lake Tahoe to learn the meaning of natural building.

programme.title: Flip Or Flop
programme.desc: Tarek and Christina get a smoking deal on a Yorba Linda, CA. They spend big money to remove a fireplace.

programme.title: Rico To The Rescue
programme.desc: A couples home addition has been continually delayed for almost a year. When Rico takes over the task, he uncovers more issues than expected.

programme.title: House Hunters
programme.desc: A couple living with parents are ready to find a home in Florida. Shes looking for a place she can renovate but he wants something move-in ready.

programme.title: My Lottery Dream Home
programme.desc: A family of six was saving for their first home when they won 100,000. David hunts for a dream home near good schools and golfing in Cedar Rapids.

programme.title: House Hunters International
programme.desc: Tensions rise as a womans fisherman husband angles to trade space and privacy for an oceanfront spot in Puerto Morelos, Mexico.

programme.title: When I was Your Age
programme.desc: Paul, 10, is a typical little boy. He goes to school, he plays sports, he is secretly in love, he tries to do as little as possible at home, he confuses his parents to get what he wants. And most of all, he would like them to finally understand that hes not a baby anymore and is old enough to do things ON HIS OWN!Except that... he has a strange gift... or curse... As soon as someone says the words, When I was your age... Paul is immediately hurled back to the time when the person he is talking to was 10 years old like he is now. He can shoot back 20, 30...70 years in time! Before mobile phones existed... When boys and girls didnt go to the same school... When there was only one television station... When toilets were at the far end of the yard... In other words, for a boy in 2021: ancient history! So as soon as he hears, When I was your age, gasp, gulp, where and when will he land this time? And in what completely crazy situation?

programme.title: 杏林在線
programme.desc: 狗隻准入食肆的措施生效了一段時間，今集杏林在線，專門研究過敏疾病的醫生提醒過敏人士，進入這些食肆要留意身體反應，因為寵物毛髮，大小便亦是致敏原，並透過空氣傳播中大醫學院兒科學系教授梁廷勳：皮毛脫出來的物質，大小便其實也有些蛋白是致敏原但那些真的要很多時候，乾了變成一層在空氣上飄，病者聞到氣管，鼻子或黏住眼睛的黏膜，便會引起那些過敏反應部分狗隻准入餐廳設有分隔區，對過敏人士有沒有幫助呢?節目會詳細講解過敏也許困擾很多毛孩主人，受訪的Gladys自小便養過狗倉鼠兔子蜥蜴，並立志成為獸醫，不過修讀獸醫課程期間，卻發現自己對貓過敏為何對狗不過敏，對貓會過敏? 為何有些人養了寵物這麼多年，突然才會過敏呢?作為獸醫的Gladys，則提醒各個寵物主人，要定期為寵物檢查及清潔香港愛護動物協會高級獸醫西貢Gladys：首先做主人也要每天跟牠梳毛，還有每天跟牠檢查毛髮，或皮毛會不會有異樣，下雨皮膚乾過，當然會容易多些有皮屑，梳有一些是很密集的，很像可能一毫米，很少很密，那些梳專門是用來解決打結的毛，甚至你懷疑動物有很多皮屑，或牠有蝨，那些專門是用來做那些事情

programme.title: 금수미앙
programme.desc: 군웅이 할거하고 전쟁이 끊이지 않던 남북조 시대, 북위와의 전쟁에 패한 북량의 황제는 나라를 구하기 위해 북위에 볼모로 끌려간다. 북량의 공주 심아는 천진난만하고 근심 걱정 없는 명랑한 소녀로 주변 사람들의 사랑을 받으며 남부럽지 않은 유년시절을 보내고... 아버지가 북위에서 돌아온 날, 북량은 북위 태부 집안의 계략에 의해 하룻밤 새 멸망한다. 북위의 공격에 도망치던 심아는 우연히 이미앙을 만나 도움을 받지만 이미앙은 죽임을 당하고... 자신의 인생을 모두 앗아가버린 원수와 그 일족을 무너뜨리기 위해 심아는 이미앙의 신분을 빌려 북위를 향한 복수를 시작하는데...

programme.title: YTN 24
programme.desc: 뉴스 채널 YTN의 기본축을 이루는 뉴스 프로그램. 정확성과 속보성을 최대한 살려 최신 정보를 필요로하는 시청자들의 욕구를 만족시켜 준다. 특히 뉴스 휠 방식을 도입함으로써 그 날의 주요 뉴스와 함께 방송시간 직전까지 기자들이 송고한 최신 소식을 매시간 뉴스 편집에 반영함으로써 가장 생생한 소식을 시청자들에게 전달한다. 또 진행 중인 사건, 사고의 변화되는 상황을 그때 그때 전달해 뉴스에 대한 시청자들의 궁금증을 해소하고 전반적인 변화에 대한 시청자들의 이해를 돕는다.
